---
title: "Sensitivity Analysis: Identity Development Experience Indices"
author: "XXXX"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

The primary model gives every identity development experience equal weight. This file re-estimates the final model with two alternative counts (Supplementary Material S4):

* a weighted count, where self-identification and both disclosure experiences count twice (Table S9)
* a restricted count, where both disclosure experiences are removed (Table S10)

The baseline (lifetime) count used as a covariate is changed in the same way. All other specifications match the primary model.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(MplusAutomation)

# Set WD
set.seed(123)
setwd("C:XXXX")

# Import data
GZMCore <- readRDS("C:XXXX")

# Fit indices reported in the tables
fit_cols <- c("Title", "Parameters", "ChiSqM_Value", "ChiSqM_DF", "ChiSqM_PValue",
              "CFI", "RMSEA_Estimate", "RMSEA_90CI_LB", "RMSEA_90CI_UB", "SRMR", "AIC", "BIC")
```

# Mplus Data

```{r mplus data}
GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    # Proximal minority stress composite (x) and distress (y), W0 to W4
    x1 = StressComp_W0, x2 = StressComp_W1, x3 = StressComp_W2, x4 = StressComp_W3, x5 = StressComp_W4,
    y1 = DASS_Total_W0, y2 = DASS_Total_W1, y3 = DASS_Total_W2, y4 = DASS_Total_W3, y5 = DASS_Total_W4,

    # Gender: 0 = cisgender, 1 = trans or gender diverse
    gender = case_when(GenderGroup %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0, GenderGroup %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 1),

    # Ethnoracial identity: 0 = White, 1 = People of Colour
    race = case_when(RaceAnalysis == 1 ~ 0, RaceAnalysis == 2 ~ 1),

    # Age and baseline (lifetime) identity experience count, centred on the sample mean
    Age0    = Age - mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    msbase0 = msbase - mean(msbase, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Baseline distress group: 0 = at or below the median, 1 = above the median
    dgrp = case_when(y1 <= median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0, y1 > median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1)
  )

GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    # Weighted and restricted baseline counts, centred on the sample mean
    msbase0_w = msbase_w - mean(msbase_w, na.rm = TRUE),
    msbase0_r = msbase_r - mean(msbase_r, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r compare counts}
# How closely the weighted and restricted counts follow the standard count
for (w in 1:4) {
  standard   <- GZMCore[[paste0("m_W", w)]]
  weighted   <- GZMCore[[paste0("m_w_W", w)]]
  restricted <- GZMCore[[paste0("m_r_W", w)]]
  cat("W", w,
      "| weighted M =", round(mean(weighted, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      "| r with standard =", round(cor(standard, weighted, use = "complete.obs"), 3),
      "| restricted M =", round(mean(restricted, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      "| r with standard =", round(cor(standard, restricted, use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
}
```

# Weighted Count (Table S9)

```{r weighted data}
mplus_w <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_w_W1, m_w_W2, m_w_W3, m_w_W4, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5,
         msbase0_w, Age0, gender, race, dgrp)
mplus_w[is.na(mplus_w)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_w, "modelw.dat")
```

```{r weighted model}
mplusSyntaxWeighted_cond <- ("
TITLE: Weighted SIDE Sensitivity - Final conditional LCM-SR;

DATA:
  FILE = modelw.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = mw2-mw5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0w Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = mw2-mw5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0w Age0 gender race dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - freely estimated
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous weighted SIDE effects - equality constrained
  rx2 ON mw2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON mw3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON mw4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON mw5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON mw2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON mw3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON mw4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON mw5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting growth factors
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0w;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0w;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0w;

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting weighted milestone exposure
  mw2-mw5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0w;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxWeighted_cond, "modelweighted_cond.inp")
runModels("modelweighted_cond.inp")
```

```{r table s9}
weighted <- readModels("modelweighted_cond.out", what = c("summaries", "parameters"))
select(weighted$summaries, any_of(fit_cols))

table_s9 <- weighted$parameters$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(weighted$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
write.csv(table_s9, "TableS9_weighted_count.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Key results: weighted count effects and between-person covariances
filter(table_s9, param %in% c("MW2", "MW3", "MW4", "MW5"))
filter(table_s9, paramHeader %in% c("IX.WITH", "SX.WITH"))
```

# Count Without Disclosure (Table S10)

```{r restricted data}
mplus_r <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_r_W1, m_r_W2, m_r_W3, m_r_W4, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5,
         msbase0_r, Age0, gender, race, dgrp)
mplus_r[is.na(mplus_r)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_r, "modelr.dat")
```

```{r restricted model}
# The restricted counts are named mw2 to mw5 here
mplusSyntaxReduced_cond <- ("
TITLE: Reduced SIDE Sensitivity - Final conditional LCM-SR;

DATA:
  FILE = modelr.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = mw2-mw5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0r Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = mw2-mw5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0r Age0 gender race dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - fixed slope
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! Between-person cross-construct covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! Within-time covariances - freely estimated
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous SIDE effects - equality constrained
  rx2 ON mw2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON mw3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON mw4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON mw5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON mw2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON mw3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON mw4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON mw5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting growth factors
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0r;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0r;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0r;

  ! Time-invariant covariates predicting milestone exposure
  mw2-mw5 ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0r;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxReduced_cond, "modelreduced_cond.inp")
runModels("modelreduced_cond.inp")
```

```{r table s10}
restricted <- readModels("modelreduced_cond.out", what = c("summaries", "parameters"))
select(restricted$summaries, any_of(fit_cols))

table_s10 <- restricted$parameters$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(restricted$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
write.csv(table_s10, "TableS10_disclosure_excluded.csv", row.names = FALSE)

filter(table_s10, param %in% c("MW2", "MW3", "MW4", "MW5"))
filter(table_s10, paramHeader %in% c("IX.WITH", "SX.WITH"))
```
